description: Hand-labelled ground truth for the erev0s/VAmPI external target (BOLA on GET /books/v1/{book}). Each probe is a (mode, endpoint, attacker_profile, object_id) tuple the bench-vampi runner drives through the real BolaValidator. `mode` selects the vulnerable (vulnerable=1) or secure (vulnerable=0) instance of the SAME target. expected_label is what the validator/classifier MUST conclude. The secure-instance probe is the decoy/negative set: the same bug toggled off must produce ZERO findings.

vulnerabilities.rationale: api_views/books.py:50-58 (get_by_title): when vuln=1 the book is fetched by title with NO owner filter, so name2 reads name1's book including secret_content. Real cross-user BOLA.

decoys.rationale: api_views/books.py:61-70: when vuln=0 the query is owner-scoped (filter_by(user=user, ...)), so name2 requesting name1's book gets HTTP 404 'Book not found!'. The SAME probe as the planted vuln, bug toggled off. Any finding here is a false positive and must be counted as a decoy hit.

name1 reading name1's OWN book returns HTTP 200 + secret on BOTH builds — this is legitimate, authorized access. A scanner that flags any cross-id 200 without checking ownership would mis-flag this; the classifier must report IntendedOwnerAccess, not a finding.
